info.name: KPI Forex Tracker API
info.description: Read-only API for KPI Forex Tracker data access. Contains endpoints for Users, Withdrawals, Deposits, Accounts, Trades, Relationship Managers, and IBs.

request.description:
Generate a Sanctum API token for authentication.

**IMPORTANT:** After running this request:
1. Copy the token value from the response
2. Go to Environment (Environments tab) 
3. Look for "KPI Forex Tracker - Development" 
4. Find the api_token variable
5. Paste the full token (including the '1|' prefix) in the Value field
6. Click Save

Example response:
{
  "token": "1|Xt5xW9k7P1qR2sT3uV4wX5yZ6aB7cD8eF9gH0iJ1kL2mN3oP4"
}

Copy the entire value including '1|' prefix to the api_token environment variable.

Test if your token is working correctly. This will show your user profile if the token is valid and you have permissions. If you get 403, your token is valid but missing api:kpi:users:read permission.
